d: The Director of Sales is responsible for developing and executing strategic sales initiatives to drive revenue growth, market share, and profitability across the hotel’s entire portfolio. The role oversees sales for hotel rooms, two categories of villas, and the newly introduced Solenna Villas, positioning each product effectively within the luxury hospitality market. The Director of Sales will lead the sales team, strengthen key client relationships, identify new business opportunities, and ensure the achievement of overall commercial objectives while maintaining the highest standards of luxury service.
q: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Hospitality Management, Sales, Marketing, or a related field.
Minimum 8–10 years of progressive sales experience within the luxury hospitality industry, with at least 3 years in a senior sales leadership role.
Proven track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets, driving revenue growth, and developing successful commercial strategies within the luxury hotel segment.
Strong understanding of luxury leisure markets, high-net-worth clientele, villa sales, corporate business, international travel trade, and key feeder markets.
Demonstrated leadership, team management, negotiation, communication, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to influence key stakeholders and develop high-performing teams.
Excellent commercial acumen, market knowledge, analytical capabilities, and proficiency in hotel sales systems, CRM platforms, and Microsoft Office.
r: Sales Strategy & Commercial Development: Formulate and execute comprehensive sales strategies to maximise revenue generation, strengthen market share, and achieve the property's overall commercial objectives across all accommodation categories.

Portfolio Sales & Market Penetration: Drive sales performance across hotel rooms, both existing villa categories, and the newly introduced Solenna Villas, ensuring effective market segmentation, product positioning, and targeted sales initiatives for each offering.

Business Development & Revenue Generation: Identify, develop, and convert new business opportunities across key international source markets, luxury leisure, corporate, wholesale, and high-net-worth segments to diversify the business mix and generate incremental revenue.

Strategic Account Management: Develop and strengthen relationships with key corporate accounts, luxury travel consortia, international travel agencies, tour operators, DMCs, and high-value clientele to maximise account production and long-term business contribution.

Budgeting, Forecasting & Sales Performance: Lead the development and management of the annual sales budget, revenue forecasts, and business plans, ensuring consistent monitoring of performance against targets and implementation of corrective sales strategies where required.

Market Intelligence & Competitive Positioning: Conduct ongoing market analysis, monitor competitor performance, identify emerging market trends, and leverage commercial intelligence to strengthen market positioning and uncover new revenue opportunities.

Sales Channel Development: Optimise distribution and sales channels through strategic partnerships, account development, market diversification, and targeted sales initiatives to maximise production and business conversion.

Revenue Management & Pricing Strategy: Collaborate closely with Revenue Management to optimise pricing strategies, manage business mix, identify high-value market segments, and maximise RevPAR and overall revenue contribution.

Solenna Villas Commercial Development: Establish and drive the sales strategy for Solenna Villas, focusing on market penetration, strategic partnerships, client acquisition, and positioning within the luxury villa and hospitality segment.

International Sales & Market Representation: Lead international sales initiatives, trade engagements, sales missions, luxury travel exhibitions, and industry networking activities to strengthen market presence and generate qualified business leads.

Sales Leadership & Team Performance: Lead and develop the sales team through strategic direction, performance management, target setting, and continuous coaching to ensure departmental objectives and commercial targets are achieved.

Commercial Reporting & Strategic Alignment: Present regular sales performance reviews, account production analysis, market intelligence, and business forecasts to senior management, ensuring sales strategies remain aligned with the property's financial and operational objectives.

d: As General Manager, I will fully comprehend the vision of Six Senses to help people reconnect with themselves, others, and the world around them, and our values of local sensitivity and global sensibility, crafted experiences, emotional hospitality, responsible and caring, fun and quirky, and pioneering wellness.

Sustainability, wellness, and out of the ordinary experiences are at the core of everything we do at Six Senses. I will safeguard these pillars through strategic planning and execution, ensuring all initiatives are fully embedded across the resort.

As the leader of Six Senses Zighy Bay, I will drive the positioning of the resort as a leading ultra-luxury destination in the Middle East, delivering highly personalized guest experiences within a complex and remote operating environment, while maintaining the highest brand standards and owner expectations.
q: To execute the position of General Manager, I must have the required qualifications, technical skills, and experience in a similar role within ultra-luxury resort environments, including:
Proven experience as a General Manager in an ultra-luxury resort, ideally within remote or complex environments.
Strong background in villa product operations with a high level of personalization and guest engagement.
Demonstrated experience in sustainability-driven operations, with a clear understanding of regenerative practices.
Strong commercial acumen, with the ability to drive revenue through premium positioning, guest experiences, and wellness offerings.
Experience operating within highly competitive luxury markets, ideally within the Middle East region.
Ability to manage complex logistics in remote environments, including supply chain, workforce, and operational challenges.
Outstanding leadership capabilities, with a track record of building, inspiring, and retaining diverse teams in remote locations.
Strong alignment with Six Senses and IHG luxury lifestyle philosophy and values.
High level of guest engagement capability, with a focus on delivering exceptional and memorable experiences for high-net-worth clientele.
Understanding of GCC guest profiles alongside international luxury travellers.
Strong cultural awareness, with the ability to operate effectively within Omani traditions and regional sensitivities.
Fluency in English is required; Arabic is preferred.
Regional experience in the Middle East and familiarity with remote resort environments is highly advantageous.
Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or related field preferred.

The above is intended to provide an overview of the role and responsibilities for a General Manager at Six Senses Zighy Bay, Oman. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities inherent to the position.
Six Senses Zighy Bay is an equal opportunity employer. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment.
Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today.
r: As General Manager, I will assume full responsibility for the efficient operation of the resort to provide exceptional products and services in line with Six Senses brand standards and financial objectives.
The duties and responsibilities will include
Lead the overall operation and positioning of Six Senses Zighy Bay as a benchmark ultra-luxury resort in the Middle East.
Drive a highly personalized villa-based guest experience, ensuring exceptional service delivery aligned with elevated guest expectations and brand standards.
Foster an inclusive, engaged, and high-performing culture, with a strong focus on attracting, developing, and retaining talent in a remote location environment.
Ensure full alignment with Six Senses operational standards across all departments, maintaining and exceeding performance benchmarks.

Instill a strong commercial mindset across the team, driving revenue through high ADR strategies, premium experiences, and wellness offerings, while maintaining cost discipline and operational efficiencies.
Oversee the strategic direction of sales, marketing, and PR to strengthen brand positioning across key GCC and international markets.
Manage operational complexity across villas, dining concepts, wellness, and logistics, ensuring seamless delivery of guest experiences.
Champion sustainability and regenerative practices, including Earth Lab initiatives, local sourcing, and on-site production, embedding these into daily operations and guest engagement.
Ensure compliance with all legal, financial, health and safety, and regulatory requirements, including regional considerations and visa limitations impacting the workforce.
Build and maintain strong relationships with ownership and key stakeholders, aligning on performance, operational priorities, and long-term strategic direction.
Respect and uphold Omani traditions and Islamic culture, ensuring cultural sensitivity is embedded in both guest and host experiences.

d: Job Title: IT, Microsoft Cloud & AI Sales Executive

A UAE-based company providing IT solutions and technology services is looking for a motivated, commercially minded, and results-driven sales professional to expand its customer base and drive revenue growth through the sale of Microsoft products, cloud services, and AI solutions.
We are seeking a proactive IT Executive with excellent sales, communication, and follow-up skills and a proven ability to achieve sales targets.

The successful candidate will be responsible for contacting prospects from a ready-made list with contact details, identifying customer requirements, promoting suitable technology solutions, following up on opportunities, and converting leads into paying customers.
This role is ideal for a sales professional who combines commercial drive with an understanding of IT solutions, Microsoft technologies, cloud computing, and AI tools.
Conduct outbound sales calls to prospective customers using the company's provided lead list and contact database.
Promote and sell Microsoft products and services, including Azure, Microsoft 365, cloud infrastructure, storage, and AI solutions.
Identify customer needs and recommend suitable technology products and services.
Qualify leads, present solutions, handle objections, negotiate, and close sales.
Maintain consistent and structured follow-up with prospects through telephone calls, emails, and other appropriate communication channels.
Manage the complete sales cycle, from initial contact and lead qualification to quotation, follow-up, and closing.
Achieve assigned monthly sales targets, revenue objectives, and key performance indicators.
Maintain accurate customer information, sales activities, follow-up schedules, and pipeline updates in the CRM or designated tracking system.
Identify opportunities for upselling, cross-selling, and developing long-term customer relationships.
Use AI tools to research prospects, personalize communications, prepare follow-up messages, and improve sales productivity.
Prepare regular sales reports covering calls, qualified leads, quotations, conversions, revenue, and progress against targets.
Coordinate with technical and remote teams to ensure timely responses to customer inquiries and support the sales process.
Demonstrated ability to achieve sales targets, meet KPIs, and deliver measurable commercial results.
Strong prospecting, persuasion, negotiation, objection-handling, and closing skills.
A proactive, self-motivated, and results-oriented approach to sales.
Strong outbound calling and B2B sales capabilities.
Ability to work effectively with a ready-made list of leads and contact details, qualify prospects, and convert opportunities into customers.
Excellent follow-up discipline, persistence, and ownership of the sales pipeline.
Ability to prioritize high-potential prospects and maintain momentum throughout the sales cycle.
Ability to understand and confidently present Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, cloud storage, and related IT services.
Understanding of AI-powered business solutions, including Microsoft Copilot and productivity automation.
Ability to translate technical features into clear business benefits for customers.
Willingness to continuously develop product knowledge and sales capabilities.
Exceptional attention to detail in managing prospect information, quotations, follow-up dates, and sales records.
Strong time management and organizational skills.
Ability to manage multiple prospects simultaneously without missing follow-ups.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Outlook, CRM systems, and sales reporting tools.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Professional telephone manner and strong relationship-building abilities.
Ability to understand customer requirements, establish trust, and maintain professional relationships.
Strong coordination skills when working with technical teams and remote colleagues.
Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, Marketing, or a related discipline.
Relevant Microsoft certification in Azure, Microsoft 365, or cloud technologies is mandatory.
Previous experience in telesales, inside sales, or B2B technology sales.
Proven track record of achieving sales targets and converting leads into paying customers.
Experience selling cloud services, IT solutions, software subscriptions, or AI-powered solutions is highly desirable.
Experience working with remote teams or companies based in India is an advantage.
Competitive salary based on qualifications and relevant experience.
Performance-based commission linked to measurable sales results.
Clear monthly sales targets and performance indicators.
Opportunity to increase total earnings through successful lead conversion and target achievement.
We are committed to equal employment opportunities and welcome candidates who demonstrate the required qualifications, professionalism, commercial drive, and commitment to achieving results.
Interested candidates are invited to submit their CV, highlighting their Microsoft certifications, relevant IT sales experience, and measurable sales achievements.
Candidates with a proven record of achieving sales targets, excellent follow-up discipline, and strong lead-conversion skills are particularly encouraged to apply.
